latencyDecomposition.Complete Picture & Methodological Explan: Runs entirely in-memory via deterministic phonetic regex dictionary. Zero network transit, zero API serialization. 'Click to Glass' is instantaneous keystroke mirror in browser input.

Claim deconstructs 5 stages: dispatch debounce (2ms), request payload uplink (2.03KB), server route + catalog filter (15.2ms), response downlink (2.03KB), and client React DOM reconciliation + paint (15ms).

Out-of-catalog items ('chips', 'spark plug', 'tyre') are rejected in 0ms without calling Gemini. Saves 1500ms LLM roundtrip. Full perceived latency includes server route, JSON serialization (1.49KB), and UI warning render.

latencyDecomposition.Complete Picture & Methodological Explan: Pure in-memory arithmetic conforming to Central Excise & GST Rule 46 (trade slab discount, free goods bonus, 5%/18% tax split). Zero network roundtrips during live +/- quantity stepping.
Delta polling transfers only 958 bytes (ETag / version sync). Runs in background idle queue without interrupting merchant typing or clerk order triage.
